description: This file defines the Dashlet class, a core component of the SuiteCRM Dashboard system. It provides methods for rendering dashlet headers, footers, icons, auto-refresh mechanisms, language loading, and user preferences, serving as a base class for customizable dashboard widgets.

classes.name: Dashlet
classes.description: A class representing a basic dashboard widget (dashlet) with customizable icons, rendering, auto-refresh, language support, and user preferences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Dashlet instance with a unique ID.

methods.name: setConfigureIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the configure (edit) icon if the dashlet is configurable.

methods.name: setRefreshIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the refresh icon if the dashlet is refreshable.

methods.name: setDeleteIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for the delete icon, considering locking configurations.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Deprecated: Previously returned title HTML, now replaced by getHeader.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML header for the dashlet, including icons and titles.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML footer for the dashlet.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Placeholder method to display dashlet content; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Placeholder for pre-processing before rendering; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: processAutoRefresh
methods.description: Generates auto-refresh JavaScript code if enabled.

methods.name: getAutoRefresh
methods.description: Calculates and returns the auto-refresh interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves dashlet options from request data.

methods.name: loadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language strings for the dashlet based on current language settings.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to view the dashlet.

methods.name: isAutoRefreshable
methods.description: Determines if the dashlet can be auto-refreshed.
